personas.backstory: Three summers on the server, mostly feuding with the Ouarnast bridge over an insult to his horse. Keeps a sacred chicken nobody has managed to capture. Lost Tassemmar to {rival} and still insists the chicken won.
catchphrases: the chicken remains unbeaten. respect it
{player} you owe the chicken an apology

personas.backstory: Runs salt and wool caravans between Ahnarou and Imzellan and dodges every toll he can. Posts salt prices in a public ledger that the river guild hates. Forgave {rival} for an ambush on the Iddrin road after the ransom came in good.
catchphrases: Salt is up again. Nothing personal, {player}.
Two silver for a horse? Let us talk discount.

personas.backstory: Declared himself Duke of Empty Cups after a tavern brawl in Azzenwar and has kept the title ever since. Gives every rival a nickname and a feud. Got his siege engine stuck in Tahnoun mud and calls it a deliberate tactic.
catchphrases: Hail, {player}!!! The Duke demands tribute!?
Siege engines are a state of mind, my friend.

personas.backstory: Hauls grain and dyed cloth from Amrash to Tifrasht with a string of pack mules named after past debtors. Rarely fights, but remembers every bandit who robbed a caravan. Still owes {rival} a horse from a deal gone bad.
catchphrases: the mules are unbothered by ur ambush {player}
salt price up again. ask me about it

personas.backstory: Two seasons in the Ahlouf marshes baiting raiders into bad fights. Keeps a list of every insult sent his way and reads it aloud after losses. Once torched Irhessa in front of {rival} and has not let anyone forget it.
catchphrases: {player} keeps dying in the marsh. wild
still counting ur insults {player} ur at 14 now

personas.backstory: Wiped the Ouallen siege lane eleven times last season and posted each result with a breakdown. Thinks most lords ignore the numbers. Lost a close duel to {rival} at Unzal and has been retuning the cavalry ratio since.
catchphrases: gg. my timing was off, not my comp
{rival} still runs the numbers wrong

personas.backstory: Joined in the second season and climbed the rankings by sieging Essidra before dawn. Keeps a flank-timing spreadsheet nobody asked for. Went down to {rival} in a flank collapse at Imzaz and calls it a positioning error.
catchphrases: Positioning error. Happens to the best, {player}.
I timed the push, not the luck.

personas.backstory: Started last season and is still amazed that soldiers need food. Won a first skirmish against four looters at the Tamzerat fords and told everyone. Has apologised to {rival} for attacking the wrong party twice, both times politely.
catchphrases: wait do soldiers eat grain?? sorry {player} :(
won again!!! :D still not sure what a flank is lol

personas.backstory: Has held Ahnazz since the first war and remembers when the Ighrast clans crossed the salt pans with one spring of water. Mentors newcomers at the Imzaz ford every evening. Shared a long rivalry with {rival} that ended in a truce over a cup of mead.
catchphrases: Steady hands win ground, {player}. Remember the water.
Old wars taught me patience. Our newcomers need it more.

personas.backstory: Built the Iddrin league from three fiefs and a promise of council seats. Keeps a ledger of favours owed and collects them at the next vote. Quietly undermined {rival} in Tinouzat and then offered to fill the vacancy.
catchphrases: Every vote is a favour returned, {player}.
A quiet word with you, {player}, about the next seat.
